title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC - Talent / Human Resources Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to ensure that partnership with colleges and universities for new teacher recruitment and pipelines are developed and maintained through development of Memorandums of Understanding, including Initiating contact with the designated staff at the college responsible for the MOU, communicating with the college and university partners about the MOU process, the writing of the MOU, and the negotiation of the MOU content, receiving approval from the District’s Legal Department, submitting and tracking the MOU through the approval process, via Talent / Human Resources Department, for the period of July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $10,000 for William L. Winston Education Consulting to set up college teacher-hiring partnerships
summary: William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC will help develop and maintain partnerships with colleges and universities to recruit new teachers. The work includes contacting college staff, writing and negotiating each memorandum of understanding (MOU, a written partnership agreement), getting Legal Department approval and tracking it through approval. The agreement runs July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022, and the Board is ratifying (approving after the start date) a limit of $10,000.
vendor_name: William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Design For Equity LLC - Madison Park Academy (Upper Campus)

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
